transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well... I suppose I haven't been feeling quite right lately. But I guess what finally scared me enough to actually ask for help is... well, I keep having these mornings where I just think... it might be easier if I didn't wake up at all. 

I'm not going to do anything. I don't have a plan to hurt myself or anything like that. It just... it bothered me that I kept having that thought.
How long have you been feeling this way with these thoughts about not waking up?
I suppose... it's been about a month. Just... since my sister passed away. It was very unexpected, so... yes. About a month.
Have you noticed any loss of interest or pleasure in activities that you usually enjoy?

I suppose... yes. I mean, I still make myself show up for things. The book club, and... the dance night. But... I don't know. Lately, I just sit there and it feels like I'm behind a pane of glass, I guess. And... well, even my garden, or cooking for the neighbors... it just doesn't give me that little lift it used to.
Have you felt down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, since your sister passed away?
I... I suppose so. Yes. Most days... it's just sort of there.
Can you describe if and how often you've felt particularly slowed down, restless, or had trouble concentrating since your sister passed away?

I don't know about restless... but concentrating, I suppose. It's... difficult lately. I'll just sit and stare at the same budgeting spreadsheet. Or... if I'm looking at something for a workshop, I'll reread a paragraph three or four times. And I still just... don't take in what it says.
Have you had trouble sleeping, or found yourself sleeping much more than usual since your sister passed away?

I... I suppose sleep has been difficult. I just sort of fall asleep in bits and pieces. And then I wake up before dawn, and my mind is already turning. I usually can't get settled again before the day starts.
Have you felt a loss of energy or noticed that you're feeling fatigued much of the time since your sister passed away?
I suppose so... yes. It's just... even simple errands, or... getting the papers together for the Cultural Center. It leaves me feeling... worn out. Like my body is just... moving through thick mud.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight since your sister passed away?

I suppose... yes. Food just doesn't really call to me much anymore. I'll fix a little toast, or maybe some soup... and then realize by evening I've barely eaten. I'm not trying to lose weight, I just... don't really think about it.
Have you found yourself feeling more guilty or blaming yourself for things more than usual since your sister passed away?

I... yes, I suppose. I just... I keep going over those last few weeks with her. Thinking about what I should have done. I should have called more often, or... just listened better. Maybe done something more useful. I know, logically, I couldn't have changed anything, but... I still think about it. A lot.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, to the point where others might notice?
I... no, I don't believe so. I haven't noticed anything like that. And... no one else has said anything to me about it.
Have you experienced any periods where your mood was significantly low or you felt hopeless for most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks at a time?
I... well, I suppose since she passed, yes. It's just been a very difficult time. It just feels... heavy, I suppose. Most days.
Can you tell me if there have been times when you didn't care about things that usually matter to you, even things you normally look forward to?

I suppose... yes. I still make myself show up for things. The book club, or... dance night. But lately, I just sit there. It feels a bit like I'm... behind a pane of glass. And... well, even my garden, or cooking for the neighbors... they just don't give me that little lift they used to.
Can you tell me if your mood has been low nearly every day for at least two months at a time, even before your sister passed away?
No... I don't believe so. Before she passed, things were... well, they were fine. Just normal, I suppose.
Can you tell me if your low mood has continued steadily for at least two months since your sister passed away?
No... not two months. It's, well, it's been about a month. Since she passed. It was... quite unexpected.
Can you tell me if there have been specific times in the past month when your low mood lasted for at least two weeks straight without a significant break?
I... I suppose so. Yes, it's been pretty constant. I haven't really had a break from it since... since it happened.

Before your sister passed away, have you ever experienced a period of time lasting at least two weeks where you felt down most of the day, nearly every day, and lost interest in things you usually enjoy?
No... I don't think so. Things were just... fine before. I didn't feel like this.
Before this past month, have you ever had a period of time when you felt so down or lost interest in things for at least two weeks in a row?
No... I don't believe so. Like I just said, everything was... normal, before this.
Before this past month, have you ever had a period of time lasting at least two weeks where you felt down most of the day, nearly every day, and lost interest in things you usually enjoy?
I... didn't you just ask me that? No. I haven't. I really don't know what else to tell you... everything was just normal before.
Before this past month, have you ever had a period of time lasting at least two weeks where you felt down most of the day, nearly every day, and lost interest in things you usually enjoy?
I... I really don't understand why you keep asking me the exact same thing. The answer is still no.
